scope: Local four-target PathMarks package/starter installation; four public operations retained. Native/visual behavior is separately accepted only on recorded CP2 runtimes. This completes the CP2 delivery slice within I2, not I2 or the full project.
decisions: Keep operation contract versions at 0.1.0; stage package release metadata at 0.2.0.
Preserve accepted I1 0.1.0 artifacts/reports. Superseded unaccepted CP2 builds are retained with correction records.
Consumers import or compile installed artifact contents and actual extracted editable starters; no new native renders for packaging.

Java checks full point/heading serialized replay and binary64 PDE distance controls. Browser/Python check installed public fixtures/replay; Python loads real py5 without launching a sketch. Android compiles the extracted project against external runtime/SDK and checks extracted core origin.
Android README uses ordinary AGP debug signing and documents pinned runtime checksums.
limits: Local artifacts only; no registry publication.
No human twenty-minute usability study yet.
No upstream pixel equality, full-corpus certification or expanded renderer/device support.
Packing, general RNG, cell subdivision, mesh/3D, branching and deliberate rare-family coverage remain unfinished; X1/X2/X3 are incomplete.
